note: Showcase merchandising for the development database, used by scripts/showcase.ts (step 5). Collections group existing catalogue products by everyday use; they make no sales, popularity, discount or stock claims. A collection is created only if its slug is absent (an existing collection is never modified), and the home sections are created only while the store has no home sections at all, so admin edits are never overwritten. Every entry is editable or removable in /admin/merch.
